description: This file defines the 'Maintenance' class within the OpenCart system, specifically in the Catalog Controller Startup namespace. It manages the maintenance mode behavior for the e-commerce platform, redirecting non-logged-in users to a maintenance page based on configuration and route considerations.

classes.name: Maintenance
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling maintenance mode logic, checking configuration, user login status, and routing to display the maintenance page when appropriate.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Checks maintenance mode status and user authentication, then redirects or proceeds accordingly.
